evidence.sourceLabel: USGS NAS
evidence.caveat: USGS NAS records are provisional and vary in accuracy, scale, completeness, population status, and temporal currency. The assertion aggregates qualifying occurrence rows for one county-species pair and preserves every raw row in the immutable archive. Archive silence never supports absence or non-detection. Coordinates were retained as lineage but were not used to determine a county equivalent.
